ClinicalDocument.title: SYNTHETIC RECORD, NOT A REAL MEDICAL RECORD — Progress Note 4 — Preventive Visit — Sugar Ray Robinson

code.displayName: Periodic reevaluation and management of healthy individual

text.paragraph: Sugar Ray Robinson is a man of 63 with mild dementia due to Alzheimer's disease, type 2 diabetes and hypertension who comes with his care partner for his yearly preventive visit, three weeks after the diagnosis was explained to him. He takes donepezil 5 mg at bedtime without side effects so far, and he no longer takes glipizide; his home glucose readings run 120 to 170 mg/dL with no low readings. He has not driven since intake, and the handgun has been taken out of the home. His new hearing aids were fitted last week, and he says the television is clearer. He wants to settle who will speak for him while he can still decide it himself. [S]

Follow-up: Eleven-week review in two weeks, with hemoglobin A1c and Tdap. Screening results by phone. Eye examination as booked. Second zoster dose in two to six months. Next preventive visit in one year. Next scheduled visit 2026-09-22: eleven-week review: donepezil dose, diabetes, hearing aids and day program. [S]

Voluntary advance care planning discussion of about 30 minutes with him and his care partner, at his request, while he can take part fully. His capacity for these decisions was assessed: he understood what a health care agent does, could explain why he chose his agent, and gave consistent answers. He named his care partner as his health care agent on a durable power of attorney for health care; the agent is recorded in the chart and is not named here. He said that what matters most is staying at home, being with the people close to him, and keeping his dignity; that he wants to keep going to the gym while he can; and that if he no longer knows the people close to him, he wants care focused on comfort at home, with no feeding tube and no machines to keep him alive. A financial power of attorney was discussed and he will arrange it. The plan will be revisited every six months and at any change in his condition. [S]
